config.world: D2v3's world with the discovery set widened by full-dimensional clouds at d = 256 (Gaussian at covariance exponents 0 and 1, the uniform cube) and heavy-tailed clouds (Student t with 3 degrees of freedom at d = 64 and 128, Laplace at d = 64), so that the intrinsic-dimension estimator's behaviour on full-dimensional clouds beyond d = 128 and on heavy tails is in the training rows. Observers, k, budget cells as before. Held-out worlds at other shapes, dimensions and observer spectra; unseen families now include the cube and a Gaussian at d = 512, Student t with 4 degrees at d = 256 and Laplace at d = 192; real corpora on fresh slices; scale cells add Student t with 3 degrees at N = 16000. The frozen D2, D2v2 and D2v3 laws are carried as competitors.
config.bars: PREREG-D2V4.md Section 5; the law, its nominal-dimension competitor, and the frozen D2, D2v2 and D2v3 laws in law.json; REF the frozen law's error pooled over every pilot row; tolerances declared multiples of REF
